inputs.name: NativePickerBridgeService.constructor.rpc
inputs.description: The RPC callback used to perform picker protocol calls for the service. The bridge invokes it with a method, parameter record, and optional options record, then awaits its result; callback failures can reject send.

inputs.name: NativePickerBridgeService.constructor.catalogPath
inputs.description: Optional catalog path passed to the picker defaults and switch services and used as model_catalog_json when opening a harness-claude thread. Defaults to undefined.

inputs.name: NativePickerBridgeService.send.method
inputs.description: The RPC method routed by the bridge. Recognized methods receive config, discovery, or thread-open handling; other methods go to the RPC, with provider checks for thread/settings/update and turn/start when params.model is a string.

inputs.name: NativePickerBridgeService.send.params
inputs.description: The parameter record used by route selection and RPC dispatch. The bridge conditionally reads threadId, model, modelProvider, config, and modelProviders; it does not validate a complete parameter schema before dispatch.

inputs.name: NativePickerBridgeService.send.options
inputs.description: Optional options record passed through to the selected route's helper or RPC call. The bridge does not read its fields; when omitted, it remains undefined.

outputs.name: NativePickerBridgeService.send
outputs.description: The resolved response record from the selected route. For model/list, data must be an array and nativeOpusModel is added if absent; other route results are returned from the selected helper or RPC.

errors.name: NativePickerError
errors.description: The service throws Error with message Close this chat before resuming with a different provider when thread/resume selects a different provider from a loaded thread. It throws Error with message Reopen this chat in the experimental client before switching when thread/settings/update or turn/start changes provider without saved thread context, and with message Invalid model discovery response when model/list returns non-array data.
